title: Bring the existing apps/web baseline into compliance with its own Prettier configuration
objective: Apply only apps/web's pinned Prettier 3.4.1 formatting output so its package-local format:check gate passes without changing behavior, tooling, configuration, or dependency state.
in_scope: apps/web files changed by npm run format
out_of_scope_zero_diff: .prettierignore and all Prettier or ESLint configuration
application logic, string values, renames, and manual import reordering
promotion or merge of the draft pull request
acceptance_criteria: A1: apps/web npm run format:check fails before the change with its exact package-local failing-file list and exits 0 after npm run format.
A2: apps/web npm test passes before and after with identical test-file and test counts.
A3: apps/web npm run lint and npm run build both pass before and after.
A4: The formatter changes only the files selected by apps/web's pinned Prettier and introduces no semantically risky whitespace change.
A5: A positive-control diff returns rows before at least three of the largest reformatted files each produce an empty git diff --ignore-all-space result.
A6: apps/web/package-lock.json remains byte-identical to origin/main by Git blob hash.
A7: The diff stays within approved scope; progress.md is a strict base-prefix append ending in LF.
A8: The pull request is opened as draft on the first pushed commit, remains draft and unmerged, and all five CI checks pass with exactly two test_stack_health.py skips in the Python job.
verification_plan: Capture package-local format, test, lint, and production-build results before formatting.
Run npm run format from apps/web using the lockfile-pinned local Prettier.
Inspect the complete formatter diff for risky whitespace-sensitive constructs and prohibited value changes.
Capture package-local format, test, lint, and production-build results after formatting.
Run a positive-control diff, identify the largest reformatted files, and prove at least three have empty ignore-all-space diffs.
Compare origin/main and HEAD lockfile blob hashes.
Verify strict progress prefix and final LF, commit, push, open a draft pull request, and inspect all five CI checks.
negative_tests: Any non-whitespace difference in a reformatted source file blocks shipment pending investigation.
Any package or lockfile blob change blocks shipment.
Any changed recurring_quota string value or whitespace-sensitive template literal blocks shipment.
data_implications: None. No schema, migration, data, evidence, offer, quota, or provider behavior changes are permitted.
security_privacy: None. No dependency, workflow, secret, credential, network, authentication, or authorization change is permitted.
portability: Formatting is produced only by apps/web's declared script and lockfile-pinned Prettier 3.4.1.
z0_risk: None. Existing vocabulary strings may be reformatted around but their values must remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
